title: PR #45956 review fixes — category rail contract, market count grammar, Products slot
description: Proves the fixes made for the 2026-09-14 review round: the market list still renders its category rail and count with the singular/plural split in place, the Products chips still come from the controller and wrap, and the unit suites covering the watchlist skeleton slot, the rail-under-watchlist contract and the singular count all pass.

gate-cdp-reachable.intent: Refuse to report proof unless the live extension is actually attached

setup-unlock-wallet.intent: Put the wallet past the lock screen so the Perps surfaces render for the user

setup-open-perps-tab.intent: Put the user on the Perps tab, where the Products section lives

setup-wait-perps-tab.intent: Hold until the tab has finished its first market load so the chips are judged on real data

fix1-wait-products-rail.intent: The Products chips are on screen for the user, not merely in the document

fix1-assert-wraps-not-scrolls.intent: Every category stays reachable by wrapping onto another line instead of hiding behind a horizontal scroller

fix1-assert-first-chip-is-crypto.intent: The chips still lead with the controller's first category rather than a hand-kept order

fix1-assert-last-chip-is-new.intent: The controller's trailing category is still offered to the user

fix2-open-market-list.intent: Follow a Products chip the way a user does, into the market list narrowed to that category

fix2-wait-category-rail.intent: The market list's own category rail is on screen for the user

fix2-assert-crypto-pressed.intent: The category the user chose reports itself as the filter in force, so the rail never holds a hidden selection

fix3-wait-market-count.intent: The user can see how many markets the filter left

fix3-assert-count-reads-plural.intent: A many-market filter still reads with the plural noun, so the singular branch did not take over the normal case

fix3-clear-capture-orphans.intent: Keep the upcoming capture on the real screenshot provider instead of a silent fallback

fix3-screenshot-market-list.label: Market list narrowed to Crypto: rail pill pressed and carrying its clear glyph, count beside the sort control
fix3-screenshot-market-list.intent: Preserve what the user sees on the filtered market list as review evidence

fix4-run-watchlist-slot-tests.intent: Show the tab's loading tree reserves the watchlist's rows so the Products chips do not jump once data arrives

fix4-assert-watchlist-slot-tests-passed.intent: Both the starred and the empty watchlist cases actually ran rather than silently matching nothing

fix5-run-market-list-tests.intent: Show the count line drops the plural when the filter leaves exactly one market

fix5-assert-market-list-tests-passed.intent: The singular-count case actually ran rather than silently matching nothing

fix6-run-rail-contract-test.cmd: yarn jest ui/pages/perps/market-list/index.test.tsx --no-coverage -t 'leaves the rail unselected while the watchlist filter is on' 2>&1
fix6-run-rail-contract-test.intent: Show the rail holds no selection while the watchlist filter is in force, so its contract stays category-or-nothing

fix6-assert-rail-contract-test-passed.intent: The rail-contract case actually ran rather than silently matching nothing
